scope: Four bounded official GovInfo records for H.R. 3633: CRI entry/context and its 3 KB text, the Oct 13 Senate calendar cover/special orders, and the Oct 13 House bill history. These sources do not inventory all potentially qualifying bills.

sources.name: Congressional Record Index 2026 H.R.3633 entry
sources.finding: The record indexes H.R.3633 Senate remarks and procedural references through Sep16, 2026: motion-to-proceed cloture references dated Aug7/Sep15, proceedings dated Sep15–16, and the Senate Banking report reference dated Jun1. This is an index of Congressional Record entries, not a bill-status or enactment certification.

sources.name: Senate calendar cover and special orders, Oct13 2026
sources.finding: The Oct13 calendar special-orders section lists H.R.3633, Order No.423, and reproduces a Sep15 order waiving the mandatory quorum call in relation to cloture on the motion to proceed. This is a dated calendar entry, not a future floor date.

sources.name: House calendar history of bills, Oct13 2026
sources.finding: The H.R.3633 history states House passage July17 2025, receipt/referral in Senate Sep18 2025, and Senate Banking report with amendment June1 2026. It gives no later H.R.3633 bill-history event in this dated document.

temporal_and_scope_limits: The index text HTTP Last-Modified is Oct16; the two Oct13 calendars were last modified Oct10. Retrieval was Oct19. These records extend the available dated coverage beyond the Sep17 XML Last-Modified, but do not certify developments after their own dates or the state of other potentially qualifying bills. No inference of universal non-enactment or no other qualifying bill is made.
